chapter: Louisville, Buck and the carnival years
title: Carnival audition and Buck being too small
summary: A carnival comes to Louisville; he and Buck audition but Buck is too young. There was a piano everywhere they went.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: it did happen that -- by travelling I learned quite a bit and I needed to learn. So getting away from Indianapolis, going to Louisville, there was a show came to town in Louisville, a big show came to town, understand? I'd say a carnival came to Louisville, carnival. And I wanted to join this carnival and we did an audition for the carnival, Buck and I, but Buck was too small. He ain't big enough for his age.
Did Buck have his own piano?
No, there was a piano everywhere we go. There was a piano everywhere. The barrooms had a piano, the Ten Cents store had a piano. Everywhere we went -- at parties they had pianos.
This Buck, were his parents in Louisville?
Your parents were in Louisville with you at that point, too.
